experiments.title: Songbranch
experiments.idea: A pixel-art dusk tree: tap a bird and it hops to the next branch and sings one soft note, and the whole tree settles.

experiments.title: Lantern Moss
experiments.idea: A calm pixel-art clearing you explore with one thumb: gather three lost lights and wake an old stone.

experiments.title: Koi Drift
experiments.idea: A still pond you feed with one thumb: tap and food drifts down, the koi glide over and the ripples spread and fade.

experiments.title: Fireflies
experiments.idea: A dusk meadow you fill with fireflies: one tap lifts a small hush of them, and they drift, blink and slowly fade.

experiments.title: Zen Rake
experiments.idea: A zen sand garden you rake with one thumb; grooves settle behind the rake and slowly fade.

experiments.title: Ripple Pool
experiments.idea: A calm, one-handed tap-to-ripple pond with soft audio.
